column1: # Explicit lazy-kernel exceptions for the workspace CPU registry-completeness test.

# _gfx11 denotes at least one of gfx1100/gfx1151; explicit single-arch suffixes remain exact.
# Native PM/builder images are excluded by the scanner, not allowlisted here.
# A module becoming registered, or a dynamic file::fn site disappearing, makes its row stale and fails the test.
